youtube.title: 🧹 This Claude Skill Unslops Your Vibecoded UI
youtube.description: Since exactly two days ago, you can make vibecoded UI look designed. It's unslop, a Claude skill with over three thousand stars. First it audits the slop: purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy. Then it picks a direction and fixes the screen, pass by pass. Works with React, Vue, Tailwind, plain HTML, even a live site. It even films your screen unslopping itself. Comment the word 'UNSLOP' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.

linkedin.text:
🧹 Does your AI-built UI look a little... slopped?

You know the look: purple gradients everywhere, glows on every card, emoji instead of icons, copy that shouts, spacing that's off.

unslop is a Claude Code skill that fixes exactly that, step by step:

✅ Audits first: lists every sign of slop and where it lives
✅ Proposes a direction, a character and a signature detail from your product before touching anything
✅ Fixes in passes: spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals, motion
✅ Works with Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind, plain HTML/CSS, or a live site from a link
✅ If the screen is already good, it says so instead of redesigning for the sake of it
✅ Can generate hero scenes and even a short video of your screen unslopping itself

Created 2 days ago. 3,359 stars, 168 forks already. CC BY 4.0.

Install: git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop ; mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/

Would you let an AI redesign your dashboard pass by pass? 👇
